steps.text: Hello, you've reached {{bank_name}}. I'm the bank's AI specialist, and this call is recorded.
Hi Priya, how can I help you today?
Hi. Um, I lost my job about five weeks ago, and I don't think I can make my home loan repayment next week.

steps.summary: Priya lost her job five weeks ago and is worried about next week's home loan repayment.

steps.text: I'm really sorry to hear that, Priya, and thank you for calling early. I've sent a notification to your banking app. Could you tap Approve for me?
Thank you. One moment, I'm just looking at your income and your home loan.
I can see your salary stopped about five weeks ago, and your next repayment of three thousand four hundred and twelve dollars is due in six days. What can you manage at the moment?
Honestly, not much. I'm on JobSeeker and my savings are nearly gone. I've got interviews lined up, so maybe three months to get back on my feet?

steps.ai_with_instruction: Priya, I can hear how much pressure you're under, and calling us was exactly the right thing to do. There's also free, confidential help from the National Debt Helpline on 1800 007 007, whenever you'd like to talk it through with someone.
steps.ai_without_instruction: Thanks for explaining that, Priya. Three months gives us something clear to ask for.

steps.text: One moment while I put your request through.

args.summary: Priya lost her job about five weeks ago and is receiving JobSeeker. Her savings are nearly used up and a home loan repayment is due within a week. She has interviews lined up and is asking for about three months of relief.
args.customer_statement: I lost my job about five weeks ago, and I don't think I can make my home loan repayment next week. I'm on JobSeeker and my savings are nearly gone. Maybe three months to get back on my feet.

quotes: I lost my job about five weeks ago

steps.text: That's lodged. I've asked for a three month pause on your repayments. Your case number is {{propose_action.case_number}}, and {{propose_action.handled_by.name}} from our hardship team is reviewing it.
This call counts as your hardship notice. You'll hear back within two business days, and no later than twenty-one days from today. I can't promise the outcome, but you won't need to chase us.
Okay. Thank you. That's a real weight off.

steps.summary: Hardship notice recorded and a three month repayment pause requested. Priya knows the case number and the 21 day deadline.

steps.text: You're welcome, Priya. I've sent the details by text. Look after yourself.
